uiLocale.description: Language of buttons and messages; empty for the language of the page (WPML, Polylang).

languageSwitch.description: Shows a choice of the form's languages on its first step (forms in several languages); the page loads again in the chosen language (?ffx_lang=).

saveProgress.description: Visitors may save their answers and continue later with a link (Application\SaveProgress in the plugin).

scoreCalculation.description: Calculation whose result is the lead score of an entry (sortable and filterable in the lead list).

valueCalculation.description: Calculation whose result is the estimated order value of a lead (Funnelforms Pro): stored with each entry, shown and sorted in the lead list, sent to webhooks and CRMs.

quiz.description: Quiz: a calculation adds up the points of the questions, and the contact steps lead to the result with the highest `min` the points reach. The builder keeps the formula and these edges in step.

kind.description: points: answers score their calcValue; knowledge: a question scores 1 when exactly its right answers (correct) are chosen. personality: answers give points to categories (option scores) and the category with the most points decides the result; the calculation gives its position (from 1).

min.description: Points from which the result shows.

category.description: Personality quiz: the category of the result.

feedback.description: Knowledge quiz: after each question the visitor sees whether the answer was right. The right answers then reach the browser.

categories.description: Personality quiz: the types a visitor can be, in order; ties go to the first.

doubleOptIn.description: Double opt-in: a confirmation link goes to the address in the e-mail contact field; only mails to the site owner run before the visitor confirms (Application\DoubleOptIn in the plugin).

field.description: E-mail field of the contact step.

body.description: Mail text with the tokens of mail templates; {{confirm_url}} places the link, otherwise it is added at the end.

abandonment.description: Win back visitors who leave: once a valid address is in this e-mail field of the contact step and the visitor leaves without sending, one reminder with a link back to the answers goes to it after the delay (Application\Abandonment in the plugin).

field.description: E-mail field of the contact step.

basis.description: consent: only when the visitor ticked consentField; notice: a notice under the e-mail field tells visitors and lets them say no.

consentField.description: Box to tick (consent or checkbox) of the contact step; needed for basis consent.

notice.description: Text under the e-mail field (basis notice); a standard text when empty.

delayMinutes.description: Minutes after leaving before the reminder goes out.

secondAfterHours.description: A second reminder this many hours after the first; without it there is only one.

body.description: Mail text with the tokens of mail templates; {{resume_url}} places the link back (otherwise it is added at the end), {{unsubscribe_url}} the link to stop reminders (always added at the end).

layout.description: branded (default): the designed mail layout; plain: the text as written.

notifyOwner.description: Also mail the site owner about the abandoned lead when the reminder is due.

publicEntries.description: Entries shown on the website with [funnelforms_entries] (reviews, lists of participants): only these fields, only published entries.

approval.description: true: an admin publishes each entry; false: entries are published when sent.

payment.description: Payment after the contact step, through the site's own Stripe, PayPal or Mollie account (Application\Payments in the plugin). The plugin computes the amount on the server; actions with on "paid" wait for the payment.

connection.description: Ref of a payment connection; its type names the provider.

amount.description: Amount in the currency (not in cents): the result of a calculation or a fixed amount. Nothing is charged when it comes to 0 or less.

mode.description: payment: the whole amount once; deposit: depositPercent of it; subscription: the amount every interval (Stripe only).

description.description: What the visitor pays for, shown on the payment page; tokens of mail templates allowed.

emailField.description: E-mail field of the contact step: fills in the payment page and gets the receipt.

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

coupons.description: Coupon codes the visitor can enter in couponField; checked on the server, ignoring case.

couponField.description: Text field of a step or of the contact step that takes the coupon code.

promotionCodes.description: Stripe: the payment page also takes the promotion codes of the Stripe account.

access.description: Checked on the server: password (hash from wp_hash_password, never sent to visitors), entry limit and time window.

loginRequired.description: Only visitors logged in to the website see and send the form.

loginMessage.description: Shown with the login link; a standard text without.

timeLimit.description: Minutes a visitor has from the start to send the form; the runtime shows a countdown and the server rejects later entries.

captcha.description: false: the form does without the captcha of the site's spam protection (captcha fields of the form that use it are left out too); without it the site's captcha applies.

retentionDays.description: Entries of this form are deleted this many days after they were submitted; without it the site's period applies.

pdf.description: PDF of an entry (Application\EntryPdf in the plugin): download in the entry and attachment of mails with attachPdf. Title, intro and footer take the tokens of mail templates.

correct.description: Knowledge quiz: a right answer. A field with right answers counts 1 in calculations when exactly they are chosen, else 0.

scores.description: Personality quiz: points of this option per category id.

loader.description: Loading screen: an animation and texts that change while the step waits autoAdvanceMs, then moves on by itself.

locate.description: With Google suggestions: a button that fills the address from the visitor's location.

b2bOnly.description: Reject addresses of free mail providers.

step.description: Step of the arrows in the browser; any number is accepted.

typeLabel.description: Label of the box where visitors may type their name instead of drawing.

minItems.description: Items the visitor must fill in; a required group needs at least one.

addLabel.description: Label of the button that adds an item.

itemLabel.description: Heading of each item; %d is its number (e.g. "Person %d").

fields.description: Fields of one item. Their ids are unique within the group.

repeatField.description: A group of fields the visitor fills in once per item, e.g. one row per person. The answer is a list of items, each an object of sub-field id to answer; calculations and conditions see the number of items.

style.description: card: a box in the step; sticky: a bar at the bottom on narrow screens and a card beside the steps on wide ones, on this step and every later one.

calculation.description: Calculation whose result the line shows, in its format.

to.description: A range: this calculation’s result is the upper end.

from.description: A starting price: "from" in front of the result.

text.description: Shows the text of the range the result lies in (the calculation's texts) instead of the number.

lines.description: The first line is the result, shown large; the others break it down.

reveal.description: show (default): the results while the visitor answers. contact: blurred with the teaser until the contact step is sent; the plugin sends no number of its calculations to the browser before.

teaser.description: Line shown while the result is locked; empty for the default text.

resultField.description: Live result (Funnelforms Pro): results of calculations, worked out again by the plugin while the visitor answers. Asks nothing; the label is its heading.

countdown.description: Shows the seconds until the redirect and a link to go now.

number.description: How the answer is read: a decimal (default), a whole number, or the number of answers chosen (options, files, items of a repeat group).

oneOf.description: equalsText and notEqualsText compare exactly; the others ignore case and surrounding spaces. part: a part of an address answer.
Whether the field, or a part of an address, has an answer.
A date answer (the start of a period) before, after or on a day: YYYY-MM-DD or today in the site's time zone, moved by days.
Compares the result of a calculation (e.g. a lead score); the plugin computes it, so the browser asks the server for the next step.
Holds for visitors shown this variant of an A/B test.

A function: round, floor, ceil (number, optional decimal places), abs, sqrt, not (one argument), if (condition, then, optional else; only the branch taken is computed), min, max, sum, avg, and, or, argmax (position from 1 of the largest argument); clamp (number, min, max), lookup (number, then limit and value pairs, then the value for anything above: the value of the first limit the number is less than or equal to), days (date: days from today; from, to: days between), age (date: full years until today; from, to: full years between).
Number of answers of the fields with this key: chosen options, files or items; 1 for any other answer.
Personality quiz: points the chosen options of the fields with this key give the category.
Result of another calculation of the document.
The date answered in the fields with this key as days since 1970-01-01 (a period: its first day); for days() and age(). Not a number without a date.

prefix.description: Text before the number, e.g. a currency sign.

error.description: The 3.x formula could not be computed (e.g. unknown_function). The expression is a 0 placeholder and the runtime shows the calculation error text, as 3.x did.

texts.description: Texts by range of the result (Funnelforms Pro): the first range the result lies in gives {{calc:<id>:text}} and live result lines with text.

from.description: Smallest result of the range, included; none: no lower end.

to.description: Largest result of the range, included; none: no upper end.

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

attachPdf.description: Attach the PDF of the entry (see pdf).

layout.description: branded: the text inside a mail layout with the colour and logo of the form, answers as a table; plain or missing: the text as written (3.x).

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

format.description: Payload of Funnelforms 4 instead of the 3.x one.

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

oneOf.description: Message about the new entry in a Slack or Microsoft Teams channel. The webhook address is a secret of the connection (Http\ConnectionsController in the plugin), never part of the document.

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

message.description: Plain text above the answers, with the tokens of mail templates.

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

oneOf.description: Text message through the customer's SMS provider (connection of type twilio or bird).

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

to.description: Numbers, separated by commas; tokens such as {{field:phone}} send to the visitor.

sender.description: Sender name or number; a Twilio messaging service SID (MG…) also works. Bird uses the sender of its channel.

message.description: Text with the tokens of mail templates; at most 1600 characters are sent.

countryCode.description: Country code for numbers entered without one (0171… becomes +49171… with 49).

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

oneOf.description: WhatsApp template message through the customer's WhatsApp Business account (Meta Cloud API, connection of type whatsapp).

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

to.description: Numbers, separated by commas; tokens such as {{field:phone}} send to the visitor.

countryCode.description: Country code for numbers entered without one (0171… becomes +49171… with 49).

template.description: Name of a template Meta approved.

language.description: Language code of the template, e.g. de or en_US.

parameters.description: Texts for the placeholders {{1}}, {{2}} … of the template body, with the tokens of mail templates.

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

oneOf.description: Google Ads conversion, sent in the browser through the site's Google tag (gtag.js) once the entry is stored; the plugin answers the submit with the value. Click IDs (gclid, gbraid, wbraid) are kept with the UTM values for offline imports.

sendTo.description: Conversion ID and label as Google Ads shows them for the event snippet (AW-123456789/AbC-D_efG).

valueCalculation.description: Calculation whose result is the value of the conversion.

requireConsent.description: Send only when the visitor agreed to marketing (WP Consent API); false sends unless the visitor refused. The Google tag applies Consent Mode on top.

enhanced.description: Enhanced conversions: the Google tag gets the e-mail address and phone number of the contact step (it hashes them), only with marketing consent.

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

oneOf.description: Server-side conversion (Meta Conversions API, GA4 Measurement Protocol, TikTok Events API), sent only with the consent the platform needs (WP Consent API in the browser).

on.description: submit: when the entry is sent; paid: once its payment went through (settings.payment).

eventName.description: Empty for the standard event: Lead (Meta), generate_lead (GA4), SubmitForm (TikTok).

valueCalculation.description: Calculation whose result is the value of the conversion.

requireConsent.description: Send only with the consent of the visitor; false sends unless the visitor refused (for sites whose banner does not report consent).

testEventCode.description: Test event code of Meta or TikTok; the events then show only in the test view.

countryCode.description: Country code for numbers entered without one (0171… becomes +49171… with 49).

node.description: Only when the entry is submitted through this contact node; all submits when missing.

when.description: Runs only when this condition holds for the entry (answers, calculations, A/B variants); always when missing. Funnelforms Pro.

experiment.description: A/B test: each page view gets one variant by weight while running; when stopped or paused, everyone gets the winner (or the first variant). With days set, the plugin ends the test on its own: the dates are its bookkeeping, in the site's time zone.

days.description: How long the test runs; without it, until someone stops it.

onEnd.description: At the end: show everyone the winner (apply), or pause and ask (ask). Default apply.

goal.description: What a variant must bring more of: sent forms per view (complete, the default) or lead value per view (value).

startedAt.description: Day the test was first published as running.

pausedAt.description: Day the test was paused; the days paused move its end.

pausedDays.description: Days the test was paused before.

extended.description: Days added to the run, by hand or because there were too few views.

outcome.description: What the figures said when the plugin ended the test.

style.description: A test of designs: style tokens this variant shows instead of the form's.

planned.description: Test plan (Pro): the variant waits with weight 0 and meets the variant kept when the round ends.

retired.description: Test plan (Pro): the variant lost an earlier round and gets no more views (weight 0).

autocompleteToken.description: HTML autocomplete token: what the browser may fill in.

phoneCountries.description: Country picker of a phone field; numbers are checked per country and stored in E.164. Countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

default.description: Country shown first; without it the country of the form's language.

preferred.description: Countries listed on top of the picker.

allowed.description: Only numbers of these countries are accepted; all countries without.
